title: 第86章 五百斤渔货，大丰收了

第86章 五百斤渔货，大丰收了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“我滴娘嘞，真的能行啊？”

“山哥，这也太猛了吧，就这么朝着水里面一放，就出鱼了？”

大壮和二壮满脸的震惊和惊喜道。

“都是些鲤拐子，不过这里估计是个小鱼窝，还挺多的呢！”李青山一边说着，一边将鲤鱼从抄网里面颠到船舱里面来。

低于两斤左右的鲤鱼，李青山都没有心思去捞。

没办法，渔货资源太丰富了。

就让他们在大河里面多长一长吧。

现在鱼的价格并不贵，比如说普通的鲤鱼，鲫鱼，草鱼都是一毛多一斤，李青山这抄上来一条，可就是一毛多钱。

鲤鱼这东西，在南方土腥味很重，一般很少吃，但是在北方的话，土腥味就没那么重了，当然也要看河水，你比如说淤泥比较多的，土腥味那就比较浓重，南方就是这样，但要是砂石河底的地方，鲤鱼的土腥味就比较淡了。

抓到后，放在清水里面养一天，土腥味也能淡下去很多。

在这里的话，就是用大酱乱炖，最多放些紫苏叶子，放些豆腐，放些花椒，辣椒……！

那小味道，一下就上来了。

对了，鲤鱼身上有一层黑色的膜，得给刮掉，否则真的会很腥。

在东北这边，鲤鱼也叫鲤拐子。

“嗡嗡嗡！”

抄网继续落在水草里面，一只只大鲤鱼翻了肚皮，李青山的双臂一颠，一颠，一颠……！

“嘭嘭嘭……！”

船舱内沉闷的声音不断响起，一只只金色大鲤鱼落入船舱，有些活跃的，没怎么被电晕厥的，还在蹦跶两下。

“娘嘞，这真的是在河里面捡鱼了。”

“这也太多了？”

大壮望着水面上一片片泛着白肚子的大鱼道：“没想到，咱这河里面鱼可真多，这鳑鲏都一群一群的啊！”

“呦，大货来了！”

李青山说罢，一条五斤重大鲤鱼便被李青山甩到了船舱内，发出一道最大的沉闷声响。

“山哥，要是按照这么上鱼的话，咱们得把沙河得鱼全抓了。”大壮一脸兴奋道。

“全抓了可不行，小鱼得放了，大鱼也得留下一下，否则今年抓了，明年可就没多少了，不过好在咱们这边得水脉都是相同的，今天抓了，过一阵子其他地方的鱼又来了。”

“呦，草根棒子！”

就在这时。

"My dear, is this really possible?"

"Brother Shan, isn't this too strong? Just put it into the water and fish will come out?"

Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang said with shock and surprise on their faces.

"They are all carp kidnappers, but this is probably a small fish nest, and there are quite a lot of them!" Li Qingshan said as he pushed the carps from the net into the cabin.

Li Qingshan had no intention of fishing for carp weighing less than two kilograms.

There is no way, the fishing resources are too abundant.

Let them grow a little longer in the river.

Nowadays, the price of fish is not expensive. For example, ordinary carp, crucian carp, and grass carp are more than 10 cents per catty. Li Qingshan bought one here for only more than 10 cents.

Carp has a strong earthy smell in the south and is generally rarely eaten. However, in the north, the earthy smell is not so strong. Of course, it also depends on the river water. For example, if there is a lot of silt, the earthy smell will be stronger. This is the case in the south. But if the river bottom is sandy and gravel, the earthy smell of carp will be lighter.

After catching it, put it in clean water for a day, and the earthy smell will be reduced a lot.

Here, it’s just stewed with miso, at most some perilla leaves, some tofu, some Sichuan peppercorns, chili peppers...!

The little taste came right away.

By the way, carp has a black film on its body that needs to be scraped off, otherwise it will be really fishy.

Here in the Northeast, carp is also called carp.

"Buzz buzz!"

The net continued to fall into the water plants, and the big carp turned over its belly one after another. Li Qingshan's arms jumped, once, and again...!

"Bang bang bang...!"

There was a dull sound in the cabin, and large golden carp fell into the cabin one after another. Some of them were active, some were not stunned by the electric shock, and they were still jumping around.

"Mom, this is really like picking up fish in the river."

"Is this too much?"

Da Zhuang looked at the large fish with white bellies on the water and said: "I didn't expect that there are so many fish in our river, and the big fish are all in groups!"

"Hey, the big stuff is here!"

After Li Qingshan said this, a carp weighing five kilograms was thrown into the cabin by Li Qingshan, making the loudest dull sound.

"Brother Shan, if we catch fish like this, we will have to catch all the fish in Shahe." Da Zhuang said with excitement.

"It's not enough to catch them all. The small fish have to be released, and the big fish have to be kept for a while. Otherwise, if we catch them this year, there won't be many next year. But fortunately, the water veins here are the same. If we catch them today, fish from other places will come again after a while."

"Hey, grassroots stick!"

Just then.
